headlines.title: Airbnb (ABNB) Stock Looks Fairly Valued After A 22% Gain
headlines.summary: Airbnb has delivered a 21.5% gain over the past year, even after a recent pullback, which puts fresh attention on whether that price still lines up with what its earnings can support. With the stock now around US$149.58, investors are weighing how much of the story is already reflected in the multiple attached to its profits. The 21.5% 1 year return keeps existing shareholders ahead. This raises the question of how much earnings strength the current valuation is assuming from here.

headlines.title: Why Airbnb (ABNB) Shares Are Plunging Today
headlines.summary: Shares of online accommodations platform Airbnb (NASDAQ:ABNB) fell 6.2% in the afternoon session after Barron’s said Meta’s Muse can make bookings itself, which is the transaction Airbnb charges for when a guest reserves a home.

headlines.title: Travel Booking Stocks Tumble as Muse Threatens to Bypass Them: Expedia Falls 7%, Airbnb Drops 6%, Booking Holdings Sinks 5%
headlines.summary: Meta's new AI agent can book a flight or hotel room without ever visiting Expedia, Airbnb, or Booking Holdings, and Wall Street is now asking whether the aggregator business model has a future at all.

headlines.title: Instacart partners with Gopuff and widens Airbnb grocery delivery
headlines.summary: Under the arrangement, Gopuff will become part of the Instacart Marketplace and will use Carrot Ads to run advertising on its own online storefront.

headlines.title: Airbnb Makes Major Push Beyond Rentals
headlines.summary: The expansion brings Airbnb closer to travelers' full trip spending

description: Airbnb, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a platform for stays, experiences, and services worldwide. The company's marketplace connects hosts and guests online or through mobile devices to book spaces, experiences, and services. It also offers gift cards. The company was formerly known as AirBed & Breakfast, Inc. and changed its name to Airbnb, Inc. in November 2010. Airbnb, Inc. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
